info.name: B3 cross-service HTTP resilience matrix
info.description: The Slice B3 headline through the gateway: a TRANSIENT resolve outage recovering within budget yields a SUCCESSFUL protected request (E1); a SUSTAINED outage is REFUSED as "could not decide" (E2 — 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE since ADR 0037, ENGINE-ERRORS; it was a 403 before: still B2's wall, no realm-fallback widening, but no longer dressed up as a policy denial). The resolve edge is fault-injected by infra/compose.resilience-stub.yaml; the runner flips STUB_MODE between passes and sets EXPECTED_STATUS / EXPECTED_LABEL accordingly. Asserts the actual cut (success vs 503 + the problem code), not just response shape.

item.name: B3 headline: id'd protected GET through the resolve edge
